title: FLA import: text-field filter in scene timeline desyncs binary parser — entire scene collapses to 1 layer
description: FIXED. Root cause: the CPicText F8 filter block (flash8-binary.ts readCPicText, ts>=0x0d) read the leading 0x01 'has-filters' marker byte AS a SWF filterCount and called readFilterList (SWF wire format). But FLA text-field filters use the AUTHORING filter format (flacomdoc converter/filters/*.java), NOT the SWF wire format: u8 marker(0x01) + UI32 count + fixed-length FLA filter records + u16 trailer. Misreading consumed the wrong byte count, landed on a spurious 0x0000 that verifyBoundary accepted as a record boundary, so the scene CPicPage child loop saw a premature null after the Menu layer and dropped layers 2-4. FIX: new readFlaFilterList/readOneFlaFilter parse the FLA authoring filter format byte-exactly (DropShadow 47B, Blur 48B, Glow 48B, Bevel 56B, Gradient* 60/61+8n, AdjustColor 23B), decoding values into the model; on a length mismatch skipToNextBoundary re-syncs. RESULT: golden-v2.fla now imports 4 scene layers (was 1); golden.fla still 4. golden-report golden-v2: 0 tag-type mismatches incl matching PlaceObject3 filter tag. golden.fla golden-report: 0 mismatches (no regression). Core tests: 320 files / 5124 tests pass.
